name: t2d-glucose-digital-twin
description: This document outlines the architectural foundation for a Healthcare Digital Twin dashboard designed for predictive monitoring (focusing on sudden glucose spikes). The stack utilizes **Next.js (App Router)**, **TypeScript**, **Tailwind CSS**, **Shadcn UI**, and **Prisma ORM**.

scripts.prebuild: mkdir -p src/contracts/v1 && cp -r backend/contracts/v1/*.json src/contracts/v1/ && npx json2ts src/contracts/v1/forecast-response.json > src/types/forecast-response.d.ts && npx json2ts src/contracts/v1/forecast-request.json > src/types/forecast-request.d.ts && npx json2ts src/contracts/v1/stream-event.json > src/types/stream-event.d.ts && npx json2ts src/contracts/v1/twin-card.json > src/types/twin-card.d.ts
scripts.check-contracts: npm run prebuild && git diff --exit-code src/contracts/v1 src/types/ || (echo 'Contracts out of sync, run npm run prebuild and commit' && exit 1)
